structured_output.summary: Single PR adding the draining scheduling state: enum, DagModel column/property/setter, migration (plus backfill index), scheduler exclusions and 5-second finalisation, auto-pause clearing, public/UI API and CLI changes, docs and a newsfragment. The React UI is untouched. Generated artefacts (OpenAPI spec, migrations reference, ERD, airflow-ctl datamodels, DB head map) need regenerating via their normal hooks.

intents.rationale: No DagSchedulingState enum exists; add it next to DagRunState.
DagModel only has is_paused; add is_draining column with index and check constraint, scheduling_state property, set_scheduling_state.
Head migration is f8c2a1d94e03 (3.4.0); add a new revision on top, update migrations-ref and the head map, and add the backfill (dag_id, completed_at) index in migration and Backfill model.
Dags needing a run, asset manager queuing (direct, alias, name/uri) and partitioned APDR creation filter only on is_paused today; draining must be excluded.
TI scheduling and queuing filter on is_paused only; a draining Dag has is_paused false so it is treated as active, and explicit triggers do not look at the flag. Tests will lock it in.
No finalisation step exists; add _finalize_draining_dags and register it in the scheduler loop at 5s.
Auto-pause only sets is_paused=True; must also clear is_draining.
Response models lack scheduling_state; DAGPatchBody requires is_paused; routes accept only update_mask ['is_paused'] and bulk update sets only is_paused.
UI list has only the paused filter and no has_unfinished_runs; dashboard counts all non-paused Dags as active.
CLI set_is_paused only filters/sets is_paused; must use scheduling state and clear draining; dags details needs scheduling_state.
Tests must be added to the existing suites for each area.

criteria.text: DagSchedulingState has exactly the members ACTIVE='active', DRAINING='draining', PAUSED='paused'.

DagModel.is_draining defaults to False; scheduling_state returns paused/draining/active from the flags; set_scheduling_state sets both flags consistently; the database rejects is_paused and is_draining both true.

New 3.4.0 migration revises f8c2a1d94e03, adds non-null is_draining (server default false) with index and check constraint, and index on backfill(dag_id, completed_at); migrations-ref.rst, DB head map and ERD are updated; models match the migration.

dags_needing_dagruns excludes draining Dags; an asset event for a draining Dag (direct, alias, name or URI reference) is recorded but creates no AssetDagRunQueue row; pending partitioned-asset events of a draining Dag produce no Dag run.
Task instances of queued/running runs of a draining Dag are still scheduled and queued, its unfinished runs are still examined, and a manual trigger or backfill can still create runs.

_finalize_draining_dags moves a draining Dag with no queued/running run and no backfill lacking Dag runs to paused and writes a Log with event drain_completed and owner scheduler; it leaves Dags with an unfinished run or an uninitialised backfill draining; Dags are processed in dag_id order with limit and row locks; the step is registered every 5 seconds in the scheduler loop.
Auto-pause after max consecutive failed runs sets is_paused True and is_draining False for a draining Dag.
DAGResponse and DAGDetailsResponse expose scheduling_state, default active, reflecting the model.

PATCH /dags/{dag_id} and PATCH /dags accept exactly one non-null of is_paused or scheduling_state (explicit null for the other accepted); both present, both null, or only null returns 422; update_mask naming is_paused or scheduling_state must match the body field else 422; response and bulk update set both flags for every matched Dag; is_paused true pauses and false activates, both clearing draining.

/ui/dags supports scheduling_state filter (active, draining, paused); paused=false still includes draining Dags; every Dag has has_unfinished_runs true iff a queued or running run exists regardless of dag_runs_limit; dashboard active_dag_count excludes draining Dags.
dags pause sets paused and dags unpause sets active, both clearing draining; a draining Dag is matched as needing change by both commands; dags details output includes scheduling_state.
core-concepts/dags.rst and faq.rst describe draining; an airflow-core newsfragment announces it (written 'Dag'); no UI files changed.
Tests added in model, scheduler, asset manager, public API, UI API, dashboard and CLI suites; existing tests asserting exact response shapes are updated.

tasks.summary: Order: (1) add DagSchedulingState enum; (2) add DagModel column/property/setter, Backfill index in model, migration, migrations-ref/head map/ERD; (3) scheduler/asset manager/dagrun behaviour and finalisation; (4) API datamodels, public and UI routes, parameters, dashboard; (5) CLI; (6) update existing tests asserting old response shapes and add new tests; (7) docs and newsfragment. Use set_scheduling_state in API/CLI paths; no new AirflowException; session-taking functions must not commit.
